crossRefs.note: After these things I looked and saw a door opened in heaven, and the first voice that I heard, like a trumpet speaking…
I heard, but I didn’t understand. Then I said, “My lord, what will be the outcome of these things?”
He said, “Go your way, Daniel; for the words are shut up and sealed until the time of the end.

translations.web: Then I wept much, because no one was found worthy to open the book or to look in it.
translations.bsb: And I began to weep bitterly, because no one was found worthy to open the scroll or look inside it.
translations.kjv: And I wept much, because no man was found worthy to open and to read the book, neither to look thereon.
translations.asv: And I wept much, because no one was found worthy to open the book, or to look thereon:
